FURVENT Phase 3 (NCT05607550) missed primary endpoint: firmonertinib 240mg median PFS 11.0mo vs control 9.5mo by BICR (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.55-1.02; p=0.0654, not significant). PFS by investigator assessment showed benefit (HR 0.61) but did not meet primary. Stock dropped ~50% on announcement. No regulatory submission planned for exon 20 indication. Lead program now effectively Phase 1 (ARR-217 in Phase 1b). Cash $373M as of Jun 2026, runway into at least Aug 2027.
